data.title: As FCC Restricts Foreign-Produced Robots, Matic, the Only American-Assembled, Privacy-Focused Home Robot in its Category, Announces Matic Cues
data.description: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., August 13, 2026--Today, Matic, the only American-assembled home robot that earned Wired's first perfect 10/10 score in 17 years of testing, announced Matic Cues. This makes Matic the first home robot to understand over 70 spoken languages along with universal human body language and gestures.
